name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v539: Cloudflare bypass fixes - actually shows and saves cookies. (1) Fixed toggle inversion: 'Hide Cloudflare WebView' toggle now correctly controls visible vs invisible mode. When ON, bypass solves invisibly (alpha=0 behind content). When OFF, visible bottom sheet appears for solving. (2) probeAndResolveIfNeeded now correctly passes webViewVisible = cloudflareWebViewVisible() so the bypass dialog opens with the right visibility. (3) The 'Open' button on AnimePahe/Kwik rows in Settings now passes the correct visibility flag. (4) context is stored in CineStream.load() so currentActivity() can find the foreground Activity for showing the bypass dialog during playback. (5) All v538 fixes retained: 30s fail-fast timeout, isUsableClearance accepts existing token, always require cf_clearance, removed dead JS cookie probe, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, Domain=.host cookie clearing, cleaned User-Agent in both WebView paths, WebView settings restored for Cloudflare Turnstile.
